name: Compassion for Animals

definition_by_age.6: Islam teaches us to be kind and gentle to all animals.
definition_by_age.8: Compassion for animals is a real responsibility in Islam — caring for their needs and treating them gently.

learning_objective: Children can describe a kind way to treat an animal.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_004). Responsibility->Repair fits the pet-care conflicts (cf_038/cf_028) this concept already links — moved off shared pattern_004 to reduce cluster size.

hd_011.reasoning: Directly and specifically about mercy to a thirsty animal — a perfect match.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Delaying pet care is a real mistake-reflection-correction shape distinct from the responsibility-repair primary.
